about: The keep-apart fixture list (hard bar M3 / A3, GLOBAL_SEARCH 2.1, B-o): every arm must keep each `fixtures` pair apart; only the operator takes a pair off the bar, by reading it as one property at a review point (`operator_card` marks the pairs to put on the RP page). M3 is scored on every fixture whose two adverts are in the scored cohort, whatever `cohort` names; a fixture listed under the cohort, or with one advert in it, that is not whole there FAILS the reader (a re-export dropped or renumbered it): re-read it against the new export and edit this file. Counts are pair-weighted (Komenskeho 10, Rychnovska 7, Ruska 6, Cihelna 6): report cases apart next to pairs apart. `convention_pairs` state identical facts once a convention an operator ruling covers is applied (`rule`: D3 identical units, the floor_convention ruling, rule 15's dum/komercni cross-type); they are positives while those rulings stand, and the non-D3 ones carry an `operator_card`. `dropped` were on the old lists (G1 neg_fused) and an operator ruling made them positives. The 246 must-not-links are not here: they are M2's (G2 `operator_eval_pairs`, the lab's rulings). `ids` is [lo, hi]; `source` is who read the difference (operator ruling, agent read, C7); every pair was found in its cohort export and both adverts were read on 2026-09-27 (pre-heal exports, listed in `exports`).
